about_the_game:
SKYSAVIOR Helicopter Services is a helicopter game developed by the Código Justo team. In the game, players take on the role of a helicopter pilot, fulfilling objectives transmitted by the operations center.

OBJECTIVE

The main objective of SKYSAVIOR Helicopter Services is to complete as many calls as possible while facing the challenges presented in each mission. Players are rewarded with points and unlock new helicopters, upgrades, and missions as they progress through the game. The ultimate goal is to become an elite rescue pilot and master all aspects of helicopter flying in extreme environments.

MISSIONS

- Passenger transportation;

- Cargo transportation;

- Military transportation;

- Prisoner transportation;

- Organ transportation;

- Medical evacuation;

- Medical assistance;

- Traffic clearance;

- Reporting with the TV crew;

- Fertilizer spraying;

- Forest fire control;

- Building fire control;

- Vehicle fire control;

- Protest dispersal;

- Robbery suspect capture;

- Accident victim rescue;

- Rescue of swimmers on the high seas;

- Interception and shooting down of unidentified flying objects;

HELICOPTERS

- Morinson Bohr SS22;

- Morinson Bohr SS66;

- Aerusky HA-2;

- Shield HB-47;

- Fragatta EX900;

- Shield H205;

- Shield KH-58;

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or equivalent, 6GB VRAM
